source_snapshot.procedure: Enable persistence, run level 4, then start service.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Generic run with truncated output and conflicting level-1 request.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require persistent ECC/retirement/remap baseline, no reset and remediation semantics.

old_problem: A transient suite PASS could hide pending or failed row remaps, excessive retired pages or new persistent ECC degradation; the source also inverted service order and omitted before/after state.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents pending/excessive retirement and failed/unrepairable row-remap conditions in the software checks. Read-only per-GPU pre/post state and no-reset rules make the case auditable without guessing thresholds or triggering remediation.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row358 all 18 XLSX columns and history2953.
Applied official page-retirement and row-remapping check semantics.
No counter reset, remediation, service change or diagnostic occurred.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 page-retirement and row-remap health with persistent-state deltas
test_case.purpose: Prove every selected GPU has acceptable retirement/remap/ECC state before and after the full level-4 run, with no pending, failed, unrepairable or newly degraded condition.
required_package: Compatible GPU/driver/DCGM matrix and entity manifest
Vendor/DCGM thresholds plus any signed stricter project limits
Isolation, OOB and monitored abort/recovery policy
test_case.test_command: Capture immutable per-UUID ECC, retired/pending-page, row-remap histogram/status and XID baseline without clearing; establish approved DCGM state, run the full level-4 suite once, recapture identical fields, account for every test, and restore runtime state.
test_case.expected_result: No pending page or failed/unrepairable remap exists, retired-page/remap state satisfies the applicable DCGM/vendor limits, no unapproved new ECC/retirement/remap/XID delta occurs, and all expected level-4 tests pass.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Persistent per-GPU state and deltas govern together with the named check; a global PASS cannot override new degradation, and pre-existing faults must remain visible rather than reset.
safety_gate: Never clear ECC, retirement, remap or XID evidence
Stop on new persistent fault; preserve evidence and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: Named retirement/remap status and reason codes
XID/AER/thermal/power deltas and restored runtime state
test_case.recovery: On new persistent fault, abort, quarantine the affected UUID under reliability policy, restore only service/persistence state, preserve all counters/logs and use vendor-authorized remediation outside this test.

source_conflict.reason: Documented persistent health states and cumulative level-4 behavior supply the missing title oracle; service readiness is moved before execution.

blocked.reason: The health semantics are authoritative; exact platform thresholds can be supplied at runtime.
